problem: load_items opens the file in write mode ('w') instead of read mode, which truncates the file and makes json.load fail.
stock_value loops over range(len(items) - 1), so the last item is excluded from the total.
tag_item uses a mutable default argument tags=[], so the list is shared across calls instead of starting empty each time.
can_fulfil uses > instead of >=, so an item with stock exactly equal to qty is wrongly reported as not fulfillable.
sale_price divides percent by 10 instead of 100, so the discount is ten times too large.
needs_reorder uses > instead of <, returning items whose stock is above the reorder level rather than below it.
order_quantity uses 'or 1', so a quantity of 0 (cancelled) is turned into 1 instead of staying 0.
